platform_info.name: Facebook
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.en: This table contains a record of your search queries on Facebook. Facebook keeps roughly the last year of search history, so older searches are not included.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat een overzicht van je zoekopdrachten op Facebook. Facebook bewaart ongeveer het laatste jaar aan zoekgeschiedenis; oudere zoekopdrachten zijn niet opgenomen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a search query the participant made on Facebook, including the search term and date.

columns.Search term: The search query entered by the participant.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was made.

description.en: This table shows the interests Facebook has identified for showing you personalized ads.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de interesses die Facebook heeft geïdentificeerd om je gepersonaliseerde advertenties te tonen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an interest topic Facebook has associated with the participant for ad targeting purposes.

columns.Ad: Interest topic used for ad targeting.

title.nl: Profielen die je recentelijk hebt bezocht

description.en: This table shows the Facebook profiles, pages, groups and events you opened in roughly the last 90 days.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebook-profielen, pagina's, groepen en evenementen die je in ongeveer de laatste 90 dagen hebt geopend.

documentation.summary: Each row is a Facebook profile, page, group or event the participant opened in roughly the last 90 days. Read from the grouped recently_visited file (exports up to June 2026) or, from September 2026, from the split profile_visits and groups_and_events_you've_visited files (an event carries a Start time or End time, a group only a Name). Marketplace visit counters that carry only a date are not rows.
documentation.source_file: logged_information/interactions/recently_visited.json (grouped, up to June 2026); profile_visits.json + groups_and_events_you've_visited.json (split, from September 2026); .html twins

columns.Category: The export's section name for the visit (Profile visits, Page visits, Events visited, Groups visited); in the split layout Profile visits for the profile_visits file and Events visited or Groups visited for the groups-and-events file.
columns.Name: Name of the visited profile, page, group or event.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the visit occurred.

title.en: Content shown to you on Facebook
title.nl: Content die Facebook je heeft laten zien

description.en: This table lists the posts, videos and ads Facebook showed you and the items you viewed in roughly the last 90 days.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de berichten, video's en advertenties die Facebook je in ongeveer de laatste 90 dagen heeft laten zien, en de items die je hebt bekeken.

documentation.summary: Each row is an item Facebook showed the participant or the participant watched in roughly the last 90 days: posts shown in the feed, videos watched, ads shown, Marketplace items viewed, web pages opened off Facebook. Read from the grouped recently_viewed file (exports up to June 2026) and, from September 2026, from the split content_that_has_been_shown_to_you_in_your_feed (Posts / Videos / Links lists), ads and shows_you_have_watched files; every file present contributes rows. Marketplace activity counters that carry only a date are not rows.
documentation.source_file: logged_information/interactions/recently_viewed.json (grouped, up to June 2026); content_that_has_been_shown_to_you_in_your_feed.json + ads.json + shows_you_have_watched.json (split, from September 2026); .html twins

columns.Category: The export's section or list name for the item (e.g. Posts that have been shown to you in your Feed, Posts, Videos, Ads, Videos you have watched, Marketplace Items).
columns.Name: Name or title of the item as the export gives it.
columns.Link: URL of the item (the share URL for web pages opened off Facebook).
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the item was shown or watched.

description.en: This table shows your interactions with Facebook Reels, such as videos you've watched or engaged with.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je interacties met Facebook Reels, zoals video's die je hebt bekeken of waarmee je hebt gecommuniceerd.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a type of interaction the participant had with Facebook Reels and its associated value.

columns.Reel interaction: Type of interaction with Facebook Reels.

description.en: This table shows outbound links you opened in Facebook's in-app browser.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont uitgaande links die je hebt geopend in de in-app browser van Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an outbound link the participant opened in Facebook's in-app browser, with a timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the website page visited.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the link was visited.

description.en: This table contains Facebook events you created or were invited to.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat Facebook-evenementen die je hebt aangemaakt of waarvoor je bent uitgenodigd.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook event the participant created or was invited to, including the event name and creation timestamp.

columns.Name: Name of the Facebook event.
columns.Created: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was created.

description.en: This table lists the Facebook groups you are currently a member of.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookgroepen waar je momenteel lid van bent.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook group the participant joined, including the title, group name, and the time of joining.

columns.Title: Title or description of the membership activity.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant joined.

description.en: This table shows your ad-preference settings on Facebook, including targeting toggles and opt-outs.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je advertentievoorkeuren op Facebook, inclusief targetinginstellingen en opt-outs.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an ad-preference setting the participant has on Facebook, such as targeting toggles and opt-outs.

title.en: Other targeting categories used to reach you
title.nl: Overige targetingcategorieën die zijn gebruikt om je te bereiken

description.en: This table shows other categories advertisers used to target you on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont overige categorieën die adverteerders hebben gebruikt om je te bereiken op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a targeting category advertisers used to reach the participant on Facebook.

title.en: Advertisers using your activity or information
title.nl: Adverteerders die je activiteit of informatie gebruiken

description.en: This table shows advertisers who used your activity or information to target you on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont adverteerders die je activiteit of informatie hebben gebruikt om je te targeten op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an advertiser who used the participant's activity or information for ad targeting on Facebook, grouped by targeting method.

columns.Label: The method used by the advertiser to target the participant (e.g. a list uploaded by the advertiser).
columns.Value: Name of the advertiser or value of the setting.

title.en: Ads you clicked or engaged with
title.nl: Advertenties waarop je hebt geklikt of gereageerd

description.en: This table shows the ads you have clicked or otherwise engaged with on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de advertenties waarop je hebt geklikt of waarmee je hebt gecommuniceerd op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents an ad the participant clicked or engaged with on Facebook, including the action taken, ad title, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Action: Type of interaction with the ad (e.g. Click).
columns.Title: Title of the ad interacted with.
columns.URL: URL of the ad or post interacted with.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the interaction occurred.

description.en: Businesses and apps share with Meta what you do on their websites and apps, such as page views, searches and purchases. This table lists what they reported about you.
description.nl: Bedrijven en apps delen met Meta wat je op hun websites en apps doet, zoals paginaweergaven, zoekopdrachten en aankopen. Deze tabel toont wat zij over jou hebben doorgegeven.

documentation.summary: Each row is one activity that a business or organisation reported to Meta about the participant on its own website or app (page view, search, purchase, app open, ...). JSON has two shapes (off_facebook_activity_v2 with events[]; 2026 record format with label_values); HTML is an index page plus one page per business, read one at a time.

columns.Business: Name of the business or app that reported the activity.
columns.Event: Meta's event code (PAGE_VIEW, VIEW_CONTENT, SEARCH, PURCHASE, CUSTOM, ...).
columns.Date: Timestamp of when Meta received the event, in the reference zone.

description.en: This table shows all the comments you have made on Facebook posts and other content.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont alle comments die je op Facebook-berichten en andere content hebt geplaatst.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a comment the participant made on a Facebook post or other content, including the title, comment text, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post the comment was made on.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was made.

description.en: This table shows the titles of posts you liked on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de titels van posts die je leuk vond op Facebook.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post the participant liked or reacted to on Facebook, including the post title, reaction type, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post that was liked or reacted to.
columns.Reaction: Type of reaction (e.g. Like, Love, Haha).
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reaction was made.

description.en: This table shows the posts and places you have checked into on Facebook.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de berichten en plaatsen waar je op Facebook hebt ingecheckt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post or check-in the participant made on Facebook, including the title, post content, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post or check-in.
columns.URL: URL associated with the post or check-in.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post or check-in was made.

description.en: This table shows your posts and comments contributed to Facebook groups.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont je berichten en comments die je hebt bijgedragen in Facebook-groepen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a post or comment the participant contributed to a Facebook group, including the content, date, and URL.

columns.Value: Concatenated text content of the contribution.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contribution was made.

description.en: This table specifically lists the comments you have made in Facebook groups.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont specifiek de comments die je in Facebook-groepen hebt geplaatst.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a comment the participant made in a Facebook group, including the title, comment text, group name, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the post the comment was made on.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was made.

description.en: This table lists the people, Pages and profiles you follow on Facebook, with the date you started following each. It can overlap with the tables of Pages you follow or like.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de personen, pagina's en profielen die je volgt op Facebook, met de datum waarop je ze bent gaan volgen. Deze kan overlappen met de tabellen van pagina's die je volgt of leuk vindt.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook profile or page that the participant follows, including the name and the time they started following.

columns.Name: Name of the followed profile or page.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following.

title.en: Pages and profiles that you follow
title.nl: Pagina's en profielen die je volgt

description.en: This table lists the Facebook Pages and professional profiles you follow, as recorded in your Pages activity. Liking a Page also follows it, so this can overlap with the other two tables.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookpagina's en professionele profielen die je volgt, zoals vastgelegd in je pagina-activiteit. Een pagina leuk vinden betekent ook dat je die volgt, dus deze kan overlappen met de andere twee tabellen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Page or profile the participant follows, including the title and time they started following.

columns.Title: Title of the followed Page or profile.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant started following.

description.en: This table lists the Facebook Pages you have liked, with the date of each like. Liking a Page is recorded separately from following it.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebookpagina's die je leuk vindt, met de datum van elke like. Een pagina leuk vinden wordt apart vastgelegd van een pagina volgen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook Page the participant has liked, including the page name, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Name: Name of the liked Facebook Page.
columns.URL: URL of the liked Facebook Page.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was liked.

title.nl: Facebook-items die je recentelijk hebt bekeken

description.en: This table shows the Facebook items you have recently viewed.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de Facebook-items die je recentelijk hebt bekeken.

documentation.summary: Each row represents a Facebook item the participant recently viewed, including the title, product name, description, and date.

columns.Title: Title of the viewed item.
columns.Product Name: Product name of the viewed item.
columns.Date: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the item was viewed.
